source: Solar and wind: EIA-930 hourly generation by fuel (Adjusted SUN Gen, Adjusted WND Gen) over the fuel's installed nameplate in the BA that month (EIA-860M operating and retired generators), from 2018-07-01: a fleet average, not a site; curtailed output is not in it.

Batteries: perfect-foresight optimum per local day from empty, hourly, full power or nothing, round trip 0.86 (Lazard LCOS v10.0, utility-scale 100 MW/400 MWh, low end), at most one full cycle a day: an upper bound.

Peaker: runs when the hub price exceeds Henry Hub x 10.725 MMBtu/MWh + 4.25 USD/MWh (Lazard LCOE v18.0, gas peaking new build, midpoints); no start cost, minimum run, ramp, outage or gas basis. Henry Hub: eia_fuel_spot_prices (eia:henry_hub spot_price, 1997-01-07 to 2026-09-22); a day without a price takes the last trading day's before it.
